name: How long does patio door installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does patio door installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a patio door can vary depending on the door type, the existing opening, and whether any structural modifications are required. A standard replacement of a similar-sized patio door often takes one day. If the project involves enlarging an opening, framing a new wall, or extensive trim work, it can extend to two or more days. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard patio door replacement usually takes one day. More complex installations requiring structural changes can take two or more days.
